tagline: Plan web research with explicit scope, structure and freshness.
introduction: A companion for Context.dev web data workflows, helping define what to collect, how to structure it and how to explain its limits.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Context.dev? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Scope a web data task
capabilities.description: Define allowed sites, target fields and a bounded research goal.

capabilities.title: Design an extraction schema
capabilities.description: Review a fictional public-page snapshot with exact field spans, source time and explicit unknowns.
inputs: fictional snapshot JSON string and allowlisted fields
outputs: source-bound extraction worksheet and validation cases

capabilities.title: Plan change monitoring
capabilities.description: Define what counts as a meaningful change and how it should be checked.
